SAM SCREEN$ mode 4: 24576 screen + 40-byte palette table + 16 line-interrupt records + 0xFF = 24681 bytes exactly. RECOIL rejects it only because the first record has line 0xFE: with that one record removed RECOIL renders the file pixel-identical to us. SAM Technical Manual v3.0: line values 192-255 inhibit the line interrupt, so that record never fires and we skip it; the other records (CLUT entry 0 changed every 11 lines) apply as in RECOIL; render reviewed: Garfield and Odie picnic scene
